top_signals.title: Bitcoin and ether ETFs draw $2.6 billion in strongest inflow week since October, tripling volume
top_signals.summary: Combined ETF weekly trading volume more than tripled to $29 billion as bitcoin and ether prices rallied, though both categories are negative on the year.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
